'''Tanith''' was a blue-skinned [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as one of [[Ukabi]]'s [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenants]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was defeated by an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]]-allied individual.
